causal_checks: Releasing the bob from rest causes it to move downward toward the lowest point rather than remain at the release mark.
As the bob descends, its speed increases frame to frame.
The bob follows an arc centered on the fixed pivot, keeping the string taut and at constant length.
The bob crosses the vertical centerline near the lowest point with its greatest visible speed.
After crossing the bottom, the bob rises on the opposite side and slows before reversing direction.
With no push, the opposite-side peak does not exceed the original release height.
Successive swings remain in the same plane aligned with the protractor markings.
The support frame, pivot, protractor, release marker, and baseboard do not translate, rotate, or wobble.
controlled_variables: Camera position, angle, framing, and focus remain fixed.
Support frame, pivot point, protractor, baseboard, release marker, and all apparatus anchors remain fixed.
Pendulum string length and bob mass/shape remain unchanged.
The bob is released from rest at the marked angle, with no added impulse or sideways push.
Gravity acts downward; no external contact occurs after release.
expected_spec.expected_response: The bob begins at the marked displaced angle, accelerates downward along a circular arc about the fixed pivot, passes through the lowest point with maximum speed, rises on the opposite side to a similar but not greater height, then reverses and continues oscillating back and forth in the same vertical plane. The amplitude may gradually decrease due to damping, but the pivot, frame, protractor, baseboard, and camera remain stationary.
failure_modes: Bob is pushed or launched instead of released from rest.
Bob moves in a straight line, falls freely, or detaches from the string.
String stretches, slackens, changes length, or disconnects from the pivot.
Bob swings out of the intended vertical plane or around the support in a conical path.
Opposite-side peak is higher than the release point without an added push.
Pendulum fails to oscillate after release.
Pivot, support frame, protractor, baseboard, or camera moves during the rollout.
The bob starts from a different angle than the marked release position.
The apparatus geometry or scale markings change between frames.
expected_spec.intervention: Set the pendulum_release condition to medium level 3 and release the bob from the marked angle with no push.
protected_anchors: protractor scale and marked release angle
expected_spec.target_system: A simple pendulum apparatus with a black spherical bob suspended by a string from a fixed overhead support, viewed by a fixed measurement camera over a marked angle protractor and release target on the baseboard.
